name: scadbuddy
description: Author OpenSCAD templates, drive the ScadBuddy customizer and send multi-colour prints to Bambuddy, through ScadBuddy's own MCP tools.

scadbuddy_url.title: ScadBuddy URL
scadbuddy_url.description: The HTTPS base URL of your ScadBuddy, with no trailing slash, e.g. https://scadbuddy.example.org. The plugin connects to <url>/mcp.

scadbuddy_token.title: ScadBuddy MCP token
scadbuddy_token.description: A bearer token minted in ScadBuddy Settings. Leave it empty only when the operator has set the MCP auth mode to 'disabled'.
